headlines.text: It was 2022 when Jon Moxley vs. Kyle O'Reilly met in a Number One Contender, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 8.17 ? a fantastic contest. O'Reilly had just won a wild Casino Battle Royale to earn this shot, and pushed the reigning ace to the limit before Moxley's experience saw him through to Forbidden Door.
